pages.text: Cast a line into $(thing)Lumenwater$() for a catch found nowhere else — native fish and flora, glowing materials, and rare treasure on top of your normal haul.
Rarest of all are enchanted $(thing)spell-books$() carrying Lumenwilds enchantments — the $(o)only$() way to get them. Apply them at an anvil.

Armor: $(thing)Lightfooted$() (boots, Lightfoot), $(thing)Nightsight$() (helmet, night vision), $(thing)Lumenward$() (chest, water breathing + dolphin's grace).$(br)Weapons: $(thing)Glowbrand$() (Glowmarked on hit), $(thing)Sporestrike$() (Sporeblind), $(thing)Rootbinding$() (Rooted).
